protocol.architecture_note: Latest-role readout hard-selects current memory; diagnostics test current content, vector correction, and final fusion.
protocol.branch_probe_note: Branch predictions reuse the trained final classifier. They are diagnostic shared-head probes, not independently trained branch heads or causal ablations.

directional_diagnosis.interpretation_rule: A correction is permitted only if one branch or scalar signature predicts stale failure in the same direction for all three seeds of both curricula. Otherwise freeze architecture correction.
